parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds all other parts such as the door, drawer, and shelves in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that maintains the cabinet’s shape and stability.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents, distributing load evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment located at the top of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a small, easily accessible storage space for utensils or small items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden runners.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal plywood board inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on design.
